saleHint: One sale. Stock, payments and customer history update together.
contextCustomer: Your draft already has a customer. Use {{name}} instead?
productHint: Tap a product to add it. Search by name or SKU.
emptyHint: Choose from your stock. We’ll calculate the rest.
quantityInvalid: Enter a quantity greater than zero, with up to 3 decimal places.
wholeQuantity: Use a whole quantity for this product.
customerHint: Walk-in is fine for a paid sale. Choose a customer when money is pending.
quickAddHint: Just the essentials. Your sale stays ready underneath.
duplicateCustomer: This phone matches an existing customer. Choose their account if it is the same person.
customerPending: Customer save result is not confirmed. Retry these same details to recover the customer without creating a duplicate.
customerStorage: This device could not preserve the customer request. No customer was sent. Allow device storage, then try again.
customerRecoveryInvalid: The saved customer request needs review. Check Customers before creating another account.
creditHint: The full amount will stay pending on the selected customer’s account.
paymentNote: Record only money already received. UPI entries are manually recorded, not bank-verified.
overpayment: Received money cannot exceed the sale total.
amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount with up to two decimal places.
customerRequired: Choose a customer to track the pending amount.
taxNote: No GST added. This is an ordinary sales record.
savingHint: Saving creates the invoice and updates stock automatically.
savedHint: Your invoice, stock and customer account are updated.
missingItems: Choose at least one product before saving.
offline: Reconnect to save. Your draft stays on this device.
draftWarning: Could not save the draft on this device. Keep this screen open until your sale is saved.
pendingHint: Your sale details are locked. Retry this exact sale to recover its invoice safely, even if stock has changed.
conflictHint: This sale needs review. Check Sales History before recording another sale. The saved request stays locked to prevent a duplicate.
recoveryInvalid: The saved request could not be restored safely. Check Sales History before recording another sale.
storageRequired: This device could not preserve the recovery request. No sale was sent. Allow device storage, then try again.
photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Photos are compressed to fit the 2 MB limit.
photoInvalid: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
photoTooLarge: This image is too large. Choose a smaller photo.
photoUploadFailed: Photo upload failed. Your sale is still here.
uploadingHint: Wait for the photo to finish or remove it before saving.
photoRemoveFailed: Could not remove this photo. Try again.
historyHint: Every sale, with its payments and pending amount.
noSalesHint: Choose products and save a sale. The rest updates automatically.
dateRangeInvalid: The end date must be on or after the start date.
cancelledHint: This sale has been reversed. The original item snapshots stay in its history.
cancellationHint: This returns all items to stock and reverses the recorded money. The audit history remains.
reversalWarning: Only use full reversal when all goods are returned in sellable condition. Partial returns and exchanges are not available here.
taxNotice: Ordinary sales record. Government e-invoicing is not enabled.
